2123717749415305403.en_summary: $SKHY SK Hynix will become Kioxia’s largest shareholder on December 4 by converting ¥129B ($820M) in bonds into a 14.1% indirect stake. This gives SK Hynix more influence over its Japanese NAND memory competitor. Voting rights remain limited until 2028.

2123717474009194994.en_summary: Citigroup $C underestimated its risk-weighted assets by about $35B after incorrectly recording trades at its UK securities unit using unapproved internal risk model. Recalculated using correct model, RWA jumped ~$35B. Citi identified and fixed the issue this summer, injected additional capital into European subsidiary. Subsidiary remained above regulatory minimum capital requirements throughout.
2123717474009194994.zh_summary: 花旗集團 $C 在其英國證券單位錯誤記錄交易後，低估風險加權資產約$350億，使用未經批准的內部風險模型。使用正確模型重算後，RWA增加約$350億。花旗表示今年夏天已識別並修復問題，並向歐洲子公司注入額外資本。子公司全程維持在監管最低資本要求之上。
